title: Sign in with School ID and password
preconditions: A fresh seeded copy is running. Use Student 2100142 (PSITS-CCS) and the demo password from the tester guide (docs/MEMBER_TESTING.md section 2). You are signed out.
steps: 1. Open the HIUSA address you were given.
2. Check that the page says "Sign in to HIUSA".
3. Type 2100142 in the box "School ID / ID Number".
4. Type the password in the box "Password".
5. Tap or click "Sign in".
expected: You land on the student home (address ends in /dashboard/student). You see "Next for you", "Organization feed" and a side panel with "Coming up" and "Your account". The side menu shows student items only.

title: School ID box accepts digits only and stops at 8 digits
preconditions: Signed out, on the sign-in page.
steps: 1. Click the "School ID / ID Number" box.
2. Type the letters abc and then the digits 123.
3. Check what is in the box.
4. Clear the box and type 123456789 (nine digits).
5. Check how many digits stay in the box.
expected: Letters never appear in the box. Only 123 stays after step 2. After step 4 only the first 8 digits (12345678) stay.

title: An email address cannot be used to sign in
preconditions: Signed out. Student 2100142 has an email on the account, but sign-in only accepts the School ID.
steps: 1. Click the "School ID / ID Number" box.
2. Type any email address, for example someone@example.com.
3. Type a password in the "Password" box.
4. Tap or click "Sign in".
5. Read the message under the boxes.
expected: You are not signed in. The letters and symbols of the email are not kept in the box, so a message asks for the School ID (the exact wording comes from the server, for example that the school id field is required). The page does not crash. VERIFY: exact wording of the message.

title: Wrong password shows a clear message and no one is signed in
preconditions: Signed out. Use a spare student such as 2300163 (not 2100142, so other testers are not locked out).
steps: 1. Type 2300163 in the School ID box.
2. Type a wrong password.
3. Tap or click "Sign in".
4. Read the red message.
5. Check the address bar.
expected: A red message appears: "The provided credentials are incorrect." You stay on the sign-in page. No student page opens.

title: Lockout after 5 wrong passwords for 15 minutes
preconditions: Use a spare student that nobody else is using, for example 2400067. Warn the other testers. The lock lasts 15 minutes and also blocks the correct password. Do this near the end of your session.
steps: 1. Type 2400067 in the School ID box.
2. Enter a wrong password and tap "Sign in". Repeat until you have failed 5 times.
3. On the next try, enter the correct password (the demo password).
4. Read the red message.
5. Wait 15 minutes without trying again.
6. Try the correct password once more.
expected: After 5 wrong tries the account is locked. The next attempt, even with the right password, is refused with a message such as "Too many failed sign in attempts for this account. Please wait before trying again." After 15 minutes the correct password signs in. VERIFY: if you type the wrong passwords very fast, a general "Too many requests. Please wait before trying again." can appear first. Write down which message you saw.

title: Sign in has no role picker; a student always lands on the student home
preconditions: Signed out. Student 2100142.
steps: 1. In the address bar, type the address of the site followed by /dashboard/admin and press Enter.
2. Check that you are sent to the sign-in page.
3. Look for any box or button that lets you choose a role. Note what you find.
4. Sign in as Student 2100142.
5. Check the address bar and the page.
expected: Step 2: you are sent to the sign-in page. Step 3: there is no role choice, only School ID and password. Step 5: you land on the student home (/dashboard/student), not on the admin page you tried first.

title: Signed-out visitor is sent to sign-in for every student page
preconditions: Signed out (log out first if needed, or use a private window).
steps: 1. Type the site address followed by /dashboard/student and press Enter.
2. Type the site address followed by /dashboard/merchandise/my-orders and press Enter.
3. Type the site address followed by /elections/1/vote and press Enter.
4. Type the site address followed by /some-page-that-does-not-exist and press Enter.
expected: Every address ends on the sign-in page. No student data is shown at any point.

title: An unknown address sends a signed-in student home, not to an error page
preconditions: Signed in as Student 2100142.
steps: 1. In the address bar, type the site address followed by /dashboard/not-a-real-page and press Enter.
2. Check where you land.
3. Type the site address followed by /dashboard and press Enter.
4. Check where you land.
expected: You end on the student home (/dashboard/student). No blank page, no 404 page and no error page appears.

title: Forgot password page opens and asks for School ID and email
preconditions: Signed out. On the public test link, reset emails are not sent, so only check the screens.
steps: 1. On the sign-in page, tap or click "Forgot password?".
2. Check that the page says "Reset your password".
3. Type 2100142 in "School ID / ID number".
4. Type the email shown on that account in "Email address".
5. Tap or click "Send reset link".
6. Read the next screen.
7. Tap or click "Back to login".
expected: A screen says "Check your email" and shows the email you typed, with a "Send another email" button. The same screen appears even for an email that does not match, so nobody can learn which emails exist. On the public link the email itself does not arrive (known limit). "Back to login" returns to sign-in.

title: Log out asks for confirmation and ends the session
preconditions: Signed in as Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Open the account menu at the top right (your name).
2. Tap or click "Logout".
3. Read the window that opens.
4. Choose "Log Out".
5. Press the browser Back button.
6. Try to open the site address followed by /dashboard/student.
expected: The window says "Log Out" and "You will need to sign in again to access your dashboard." After confirming you are on the sign-in page. Back and the direct address do not show any student page.

title: Changing the password on one device signs the other device out
preconditions: Student 2300163 (spare). You have a phone and a laptop, or two different browsers. Tell nobody else to use this account.
steps: 1. Sign in as 2300163 on the phone.
2. Sign in as 2300163 on the laptop.
3. On the laptop, open Profile, then "Password & security", and change the password (see the Profile cases for the exact steps).
4. Go back to the phone and tap any menu item, for example Events.
expected: The phone is sent back to the sign-in page. The laptop stays signed in and shows "Password updated. Your other devices were signed out." Write the new password down in your private notes and tell the demo owner. VERIFY: the phone may need one more tap before it notices.

title: Sign-in page fits a phone screen
preconditions: A phone, or a laptop browser made about 390 pixels wide. Signed out.
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page on the phone.
2. Check that you can see both boxes and the "Sign in" button without moving the page sideways.
3. Tap the School ID box and look at the keyboard that opens.
4. Tap the "Password" box and type a few characters.
5. Check the button used to show or hide the password, if there is one.
expected: There is no sideways scroll. The School ID box opens a number keyboard. The "Sign in" button is easy to tap with a thumb. VERIFY: whether a show/hide password button exists and is large enough to tap.

title: Imported student is asked to choose a new password at first sign-in
preconditions: Sequence: an Admin (900001) first imports a class list with a new student (Members, Programs and sections, Import class list) and downloads the temporary passwords file. Use the new student School ID and the temporary password from that file. Seeded demo students are NOT forced to change their password.
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page.
2. Type the new student School ID.
3. Type the temporary password from the downloaded file.
4. Tap or click "Sign in".
5. Read the page that opens.
expected: You do not see the student home. The page says "Choose a new password" and "Your account was created with a default password. Set your own before you continue." It has three boxes: "Current password", "New password" (hint: Use at least 8 characters.) and "Confirm new password", and a "Save new password" button.

title: Nothing else opens until the password is changed
preconditions: You are on the "Choose a new password" page after signing in as an imported student. Do not save a new password yet.
steps: 1. In the address bar, type the site address followed by /dashboard/student and press Enter.
2. Check where you land.
3. Type the site address followed by /dashboard/merchandise/order-merchandise and press Enter.
4. Check where you land.
5. Press the browser Back button twice.
6. Check where you land.
expected: Every time you end on "Choose a new password". No student page, menu or data can be opened.

title: Change password form checks each box
preconditions: You are on the "Choose a new password" page as an imported student.
steps: 1. Leave all three boxes empty and tap "Save new password".
2. Read the messages under the boxes.
3. Type the temporary password in "Current password". Type abc in "New password" and in "Confirm new password".
4. Tap "Save new password" and read the message.
5. Type a new password of 8 or more characters in "New password" and a different one in "Confirm new password".
6. Tap "Save new password" and read the message.
expected: Step 2: "Enter your current password.", "Use at least 8 characters." and "The confirmation does not match." are shown (the page puts your cursor in the first box with a problem). Step 4: "Use at least 8 characters.". Step 6: "The confirmation does not match.". Nothing is saved.

title: Wrong current password is refused
preconditions: You are on the "Choose a new password" page as an imported student.
steps: 1. Type a wrong password in "Current password".
2. Type a good new password (8 or more characters) in both other boxes.
3. Tap "Save new password".
4. Read the message.
expected: The password is not changed. A message appears under the "Current password" box (the server wording mentions the current password). You can try again. VERIFY: exact wording.

title: Saving a new password opens the student home and retires the temporary one
preconditions: You are on the "Choose a new password" page as an imported student.
steps: 1. Type the temporary password in "Current password".
2. Type a new password of 8 or more characters in "New password" and again in "Confirm new password".
3. Tap "Save new password".
4. Check the page that opens.
5. Log out, then try to sign in with the temporary password.
6. Sign in with the new password.
expected: Step 4: you land on the student home. Step 5: the temporary password is refused. Step 6: the new password signs in and goes straight to the student home with no change-password screen.

title: Forced password change works on a phone
preconditions: Same imported student, new temporary password (or a second imported student). A phone.
steps: 1. Sign in on the phone with the temporary password.
2. Check that all three boxes and the "Save new password" button are visible without sideways scroll.
3. Fill the three boxes and tap "Save new password".
4. Check the page that opens.
expected: The form fits the screen and the buttons are easy to tap. After saving you land on the student home.

title: Student home shows the feed, shortcuts and account lines
preconditions: Signed in as Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Sign in and wait for the home page to finish loading.
2. Find the "Next for you" checklist.
3. Find the "Organization feed" heading with the line "Updates from your organization and the university."
4. Find the side panel with "Coming up" and "Your account".
5. Read the two links under "Your account".
expected: All four areas are there. "Your account" has "Statement of account" (with a line such as "You owe ..." or "Nothing owed") and "My clearance" (with a line such as "Clearance: Cleared", "Clearance: N signatures pending", "On hold: see My clearance" or "No clearance period").

title: Next for you checklist ticks when you act
preconditions: Student 2100142 or another seeded student who has not registered for any event yet. Do the Events registration case first.
steps: 1. Open the home page and find "Next for you".
2. Look for the step "Register for an upcoming event".
3. Register for an event (see the Events cases).
4. Open the home page again.
expected: Before registering, the step "Register for an upcoming event" is listed as not done. After registering, it is gone or marked done. Other steps ("Add your contact number", "Enroll your fingerprint") stay until done. The fingerprint step has no link because it is done in person with the officers.

title: Active election card on the home page leads to the ballot
preconditions: Sequence: an election is open for voting (Admin created it, Department Head approved it, Admin finalized it, and its time window has started). Student has not voted yet.
steps: 1. Open the student home.
2. Find the card "Active election" in the side panel.
3. Tap or click "Enter secure voting".
4. Check the page that opens.
expected: The card shows the election title and the line "Review the candidates and cast your ballot before voting closes." The button opens the Secure Voting ballot page for that election with a "Start my ballot" button.

title: Account shortcuts open Statement of account and My clearance
preconditions: Signed in as Student 2100142.
steps: 1. On the student home, tap or click "Statement of account" under "Your account".
2. Check the page title and then press Back.
3. Tap or click "My clearance" under "Your account".
4. Check the page title.
expected: The first link opens the Statement of account page. The second opens the My clearance page. Each row is at least about 56 pixels tall so it is easy to tap.

title: Home on a phone has no sideways scroll and shortcuts come first
preconditions: A phone (or browser about 390 pixels wide). Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Sign in on the phone.
2. Look at the top of the home page below the top bar.
3. Scroll down slowly to the end of the first screen of the feed.
4. Try to drag the page left and right.
expected: The side panel ("Active election", "Coming up", "Your account") appears above the feed on a phone. The page never moves sideways. Pictures in the feed stay inside the screen.

title: Laptop menu lists only student items
preconditions: Laptop browser, wide window. Signed in as Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Look at the left side menu.
2. Click each group that has an arrow to open it: My payments, Voting, Store, Support.
3. Write down every label you see, including the two links at the bottom.
expected: You see: Dashboard; My payments (Statement of account, Receipts); Events; Voting (Vote, Results); Store (Shop, My orders); Announcements (under Updates); Support (My clearance, My grievances); and at the bottom Profile and Study objectives. You do NOT see People, Finance, Ledger, Inventory, Orders, Claim desk, Check-in, Tasks, Approvals, Candidates, Voters, Compliance, Grievances, Clearance signing or Audit log. VERIFY: whether Events and Announcements show as a single link or as a group with one child.

title: Phone menu drawer opens, scrolls and closes
preconditions: A phone (or browser about 390 pixels wide). Signed in as Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Tap the menu button (three lines) at the top left. Its name is "Open menu".
2. Check that a menu panel slides in over the page.
3. Tap a group such as "Store" and then "Shop".
4. Check that the Shop page opens and the menu closes.
5. Open the menu again and tap "Close menu" (the X).
expected: The panel opens, the group opens to show its pages, tapping a page goes there and closes the panel, and the X closes it without going anywhere. The page behind does not scroll sideways.

title: Phone menu items are easy to tap
preconditions: A phone. Signed in as Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Open the menu with "Open menu".
2. Try to tap each group and each page name with your thumb.
3. Note any item you tapped wrongly or had to tap twice.
4. Check that the "Logout" button at the bottom of the menu is reachable.
expected: Every menu row can be tapped the first time with a thumb (rows should be about 44 pixels tall or more). Logout is reachable by scrolling inside the menu. Report any row that is too small. VERIFY: the top-left menu button itself is about 40 pixels, slightly under 44.

title: Go to page search finds only student pages
preconditions: Signed in as Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Click "Go to page" in the top bar (or press Ctrl and K).
2. Type shop and look at the results.
3. Clear the box, type inventory and look at the results.
4. Clear the box, type audit and look at the results.
5. Choose a result such as "Shop" and press Enter.
expected: "Shop" is found and opens the Shop page. "Inventory" and "Audit" find nothing, because a student has no such pages. The search never lists a page the student cannot open.

title: Events list shows only approved, ongoing or completed events
preconditions: Before the SAO opens a semester (see section 3 of the tester guide), the seeded events are visible. Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Open Events from the menu.
2. Look at the list. The default view is the list.
3. Open the "Status" filter and note which statuses are offered.
4. Look through the list for any event marked Planning or Cancelled.
expected: You see events such as "Sports Fest 2024". Events that are still being planned or are waiting for approval do not appear in the list for a student. VERIFY: the Status filter may still list Planning and Cancelled as choices, but choosing them should show nothing.

title: Join an event and see "You are registered"
preconditions: Before the SAO opens a semester. A student who has not registered yet (try 2400093, 2400067, 2300247, 2400019 or 2300312). An approved event that has not started.
steps: 1. Open Events from the menu.
2. Click an event, for example "Sports Fest 2024".
3. In the window that opens, find the section "Event registration".
4. Tap or click "Register for this event".
5. Read the message and the steps.
expected: A short message "You are registered" appears. The window shows "You are registered" with a Registered badge, the line "You registered on <date>. Organizers will expect you at check-in.", a "Cancel registration" button and three steps: Register (done), Check in at the event (current), Attendance on record (not yet). Total clicks from the home page: about 3.

title: Cancel a registration and register again
preconditions: The student is registered for an upcoming event (previous case).
steps: 1. Open Events and click the event you registered for.
2. Tap or click "Cancel registration".
3. Read the message and the status.
4. Tap or click "Register for this event" again.
5. Read the message and the status.
expected: Cancelling shows "Registration cancelled" and the status Cancelled with the line "You cancelled earlier. You can register again while spots remain." Registering again works and shows "You are registered". You can never register twice at the same time: while registered, only "Cancel registration" is offered.

title: Registration is closed once the event has started
preconditions: An approved event whose start time has already passed (ongoing or completed). Student 2100142 has not registered for it.
steps: 1. Open Events and click the event that has already started.
2. Look at the section "Event registration".
3. Look for a "Register for this event" button.
expected: There is no Register button. The text says "Registration closed when this event started." The first step Register shows as blocked or closed.

title: Full event refuses new registrations
preconditions: Sequence: an Admin sets a very small expected participants number (for example 1) on an approved upcoming event, and one student registers. Then use a second student.
steps: 1. Student A registers for the small event.
2. Sign in as Student B on another browser.
3. Open Events and click the same event.
4. Tap or click "Register for this event".
5. Read the message.
expected: Student B is refused with a message: "This event has reached its registration capacity. Please check back in case a spot opens up." Student B is not registered. If Student A cancels, Student B can register.

title: Draft or planning events are hidden from students
preconditions: Sequence: an Admin (900001) creates a new event but does not get it approved, so it stays in planning. Student 2100142.
steps: 1. As the Admin, create an event with a clear name such as "QA hidden draft" and leave it unapproved.
2. As Student 2100142, open Events (list view).
3. Search for "QA hidden draft" in the "Search events" box.
4. Switch to the calendar view and look for the same date.
5. Check "Coming up" on the student home.
expected: The draft event appears nowhere: not in the list, not in the calendar and not in "Coming up". It appears for the student only after the Department Head approves it.

title: List filters: search, date, status and sort
preconditions: Student 2100142 with at least two events visible.
steps: 1. Open Events in list view.
2. Type part of an event title in "Search events".
3. Clear the search and pick a date in "Event date".
4. Clear the date and open "Sort by". Try Soonest, Latest date, Newest created and Title.
5. Use the clear option to remove all filters.
expected: The list narrows and reorders for each choice and the count of events updates. Clearing filters brings the full list back.

title: Events on a phone: list, calendar agenda and details window
preconditions: A phone (or browser about 390 pixels wide). Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Open the menu, then tap "Events".
2. Scroll the list and tap an event.
3. In the details window, scroll to "Register for this event" and tap it.
4. Close the window.
5. Tap "Calendar view" and check how the events are shown.
expected: The list and the details window fit the screen with no sideways scroll. The Register button is easy to tap. The calendar shows an agenda (a list by day) on a narrow screen instead of a tiny grid. The List and Calendar switch keeps its icons even though the words are hidden.

title: Student cannot check themselves in; officer check-in turns the status to Attended
preconditions: Sequence: Student 2100142 is registered for an event that is ongoing. Officer 900004 (or Admin 900001) is on another device on Events and tasks, Check-in.
steps: 1. As the student, open the event and read the "Event registration" section.
2. Look for any button that lets you check in yourself.
3. As the officer, check this student in on the Check-in page.
4. As the student, close and reopen the event.
5. Read the status and the three steps.
expected: The student has no self check-in button. After the officer checks the student in, the status is Attended with the message "Your attendance at this event is on record." and all three steps are done. If the event ends without a check-in the status becomes No-show ("You registered but no check-in was recorded for this event.").

title: Opening staff event pages sends the student home
preconditions: Signed in as Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Type the site address followed by /dashboard/events/manage-events and press Enter.
2. Check the page.
3. Type the site address followed by /dashboard/events/check-in and press Enter.
4. Check the page.
5. Type the site address followed by /dashboard/events/event-planner and press Enter.
6. Check the page.
expected: Each time you end on the student home (/dashboard/student). No error page (403) and no Create event or Check-in screen appears.

title: After the SAO opens a semester the seeded events leave the list
preconditions: Sequence: the SAO (990001) activates a semester (tester guide section 3). Student 2100142 had 3 events before this.
steps: 1. Before the SAO acts, note the events in Events and in "Coming up".
2. The SAO adds a semester and chooses "Set as active".
3. Reload Events as the student.
4. Reload the student home.
expected: The seeded events, which belong to no semester, no longer show for the student. The list shows an empty-list message and "Coming up" says "No upcoming events yet." This is expected, not a bug. New events the Admin creates inside the semester appear after approval.

title: Vote page with no open election
preconditions: No election is open for voting (fresh seed: the seeded election is not finalized, so a student cannot vote in it). Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Open the menu and tap "Voting".
2. Tap "Vote".
3. Read the page.
expected: You see "No election is open for voting" and "Elections appear here when the Admin opens one. Check back during the election period." There is no Vote button. VERIFY: if the seeded election card appears, it should read Upcoming and show "The ballot is still being built. Voting opens after the Admin finalizes it."

title: Open election appears as a card with a Vote button
preconditions: Sequence: Admin 900001 creates an election, Department Head 940001 approves it, Admin adds a party list and a candidate for each position, then finalizes the ballot, and the start time has passed. Student 2100142 has not voted. VERIFY: whether a student can vote in an election made this way (the tester guide says it was not tried).
steps: 1. Open Voting, then Vote.
2. Read the election card.
3. Look at the badge, the dates, the time range and the room line.
4. Find the button on the card.
expected: One card shows the election title, an "Open" badge, the date, the time range with minutes, and "Online ballot" (or the room). The button reads "Vote in this election". A line "Results:" shows whether results can be seen.

title: Cast a full ballot and get a receipt
preconditions: An election is open and the student has not voted. Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Open Voting, Vote and tap "Vote in this election".
2. Read the overview page "Official ballot" and tap "Start my ballot".
3. On each position, tap one candidate card, then tap "Next position".
4. On the last position tap "Review ballot".
5. Check the list on "Review your ballot", then tap "Submit final ballot".
6. In the window "Submit your final ballot?" tap "Confirm and submit".
expected: The page "Ballot submitted" appears with "Your choices were securely recorded and cannot be changed." and a "Ballot receipt hash". "Your selections" lists your choices. Total clicks from the home page: 6. Tapping "Back to Vote" returns to the Vote page where the card shows Voted.

title: A choice is required for every position
preconditions: An election is open and the student has not voted.
steps: 1. Start the ballot with "Start my ballot".
2. On the first position, tap "Next position" without choosing a candidate.
3. Read the message.
4. Choose a candidate and move on. Skip choosing on the next position and use the position list to jump to the review step if possible.
5. On the review page, read the warning.
expected: Step 3: "Select a candidate before continuing." appears and you cannot move on. On the review page a position with no choice shows "Not selected" and the warning "Complete all positions before final submission." The "Submit final ballot" button stays disabled until every position has a choice.

title: Leaving the ballot asks first and records nothing
preconditions: An election is open and the student has not voted.
steps: 1. Start the ballot and choose a candidate for the first position.
2. Tap "Exit ballot" at the top right.
3. Read the window "Leave secure voting?".
4. Tap "Continue voting" and check your choice is still there.
5. Tap "Exit ballot" again and tap "Leave voting".
6. Check the Vote page.
expected: The window says only a submitted ballot is recorded and that unsubmitted choices cannot be recovered. "Continue voting" keeps you in. "Leave voting" goes back to the Vote page, which still shows Open and you can start again.

title: Second vote is refused with a friendly message
preconditions: The student has already voted in the open election (previous case).
steps: 1. Open Voting, then Vote.
2. Check the badge on the election card.
3. Open the ballot address again: type the site address followed by /elections/ and the election number and /vote. The number is in the address bar when you first opened the ballot.
4. Read the page that opens.
expected: The card shows Voted and "Your ballot receipt" with the same code. The ballot address shows "Vote already recorded" and "Each voter can submit one ballot for this election." with the receipt and a "Back to elections" button. It is never an error page and no second ballot is created.

title: Voting twice from two tabs at the same time
preconditions: An election is open. Student 2100217 has not voted. Two browser tabs signed in as the same student.
steps: 1. In tab 1 and tab 2 open the ballot for the same election and choose the same candidates.
2. In tab 1 submit the final ballot and note the receipt.
3. In tab 2 submit the final ballot.
4. Read the result in tab 2.
5. Open Voting, Vote and count the receipts.
expected: Tab 1 shows the receipt. Tab 2 shows "Vote already recorded" (no error page, no crash). The student has exactly one ballot receipt.

title: Voting after the election closed
preconditions: Sequence: an election that has ended (Admin closed it or the end time passed). Student has not voted.
steps: 1. Open Voting, Vote and read the election card.
2. Look for a Vote button.
3. If you have the ballot address from earlier, open it again: the site address followed by /elections/ and the number and /vote.
4. Read the page.
expected: The card shows Closed and the text "Voting has ended for this election." with no vote button. The old ballot address does not let you vote. It shows "No election is currently open." with "This election is not currently accepting ballots." or, if results are not released, "Unable to open this ballot" with a message that students can only open active elections or visible results. VERIFY: which of these two pages appears.

title: Election that has not opened yet cannot be voted in
preconditions: An election that is approved but its start time is in the future, or whose ballot is not finalized.
steps: 1. Open Voting, Vote.
2. Read the text on the election card.
3. Look for a Vote button.
expected: The card shows Upcoming. With a finalized ballot it says "Voting opens <date and time>. Come back then to cast your ballot." Without a finalized ballot it says "The ballot is still being built. Voting opens after the Admin finalizes it." There is no vote button.

title: Live totals while voting is open and results are released
preconditions: An election is open and results are released (the default). The student has voted.
steps: 1. Open Voting, Vote and find the line "Results:" on the election card.
2. Tap "View live totals".
3. Read the top of the Results page.
4. Look for any list of who voted for whom.

title: Browse the shop: search, category and sort

title: Quantity above the stock is refused

preconditions: Signed in as Student 2300312 (or 2400019). An item in stock.

With more than one cart item, the GCash choice is disabled and the page explains to checkout one product at a time.

title: Touch targets on a phone are big enough
preconditions: A phone. Student 2100142.
steps: 1. On the home page, try the buttons in the top bar: menu, "Go to page", cart, bell and account.
2. On Shop, try "Add to Cart" and the quantity box.

4. Write down every button you missed or had to tap twice.
expected: Buttons can be tapped on the first try and are about 44 pixels tall or more. Report any smaller button with the page name. VERIFY: the top-left menu button is about 40 pixels.

title: Vote in an election that was built inside the active semester
preconditions: Round 2: the SAO has activated a semester. Sequence: Admin 900001 creates an election inside the semester, Department Head 940001 approves it, Admin adds a party list and one candidate for every position, then finalizes the ballot, and voting has opened. Student 2100142 has not voted. The MEMBER_TESTING guide says nobody has tried this path yet.
steps: 1. Open Voting, then Vote.
2. Find the election card. Read the badge and the button.
3. Tap "Vote in this election", then "Start my ballot".
4. On each position tap one candidate and tap "Next position". On the last one tap "Review ballot".
5. Tap "Submit final ballot" and then "Confirm and submit".
6. Tap "Back to Vote" and read the card. Then open Voting, Results.
expected: The card shows an "Open" badge and the button "Vote in this election". The page "Ballot submitted" shows a "Ballot receipt hash". The Vote page then shows the election as Voted. Results shows "Live vote totals" without any voter names. No message about a closed semester appears. VERIFY: nobody has run this path before. If the card is missing, the button is greyed or the vote is refused, write down the exact words and the time, and report it as Blocked.
round: Round 2 (after the SAO activates a semester)
depends: Run after ADM-152, DH-046, ADM-161, ADM-163 and ADM-166

title: An event cleared by the Admin, the Department Head and the SAO shows up with a notification
preconditions: Round 2: the SAO has activated a semester. Sequence: Admin 900001 proposes an event inside the semester, Department Head 940001 approves it, Admin sends the SAO files and the SAO approves the event. Keep Student 2100142 signed in on a second device or window before the last approval. If the event needs no SAO files, the head's approval is the last one.
steps: 1. As the student, open Events and look for the new event title.
2. The last approver approves the event.
3. Reload the page. Click the bell at the top.
4. Click the notification "Event Approved: <event title>".
5. Open Events again and switch to the Calendar view. Find the event on its date.
expected: Before the last approval the event is not in the list. After it, the bell shows one new notification "Event Approved: <event title>" with the text "A new approved event is now available in the activity calendar." Clicking it opens the event. The event is in the Events list with the status Approved and in the Calendar view on the right day. The Admin who proposed it does not get this notice. VERIFY: the exact page the notification opens.
round: Round 2 (after the SAO activates a semester)
depends: Run after ADM-062 and DH-041 (and after ADM-069 and SAO-059 when SAO files apply)

title: A student who already attended cannot register again or cancel
preconditions: Student 2100142 registered for an approved event that has not started (see STU-029). Officer 900004 will check this student in on another device. Open the event window on two tabs before the check-in.
steps: 1. In tab 1 and tab 2 open the event. Both show "You are registered" and a "Cancel registration" button.
2. The officer checks Student 2100142 in (Events and tasks, Check-in).
3. In tab 1 reload the event. Read the status, the message and the buttons.
4. In tab 2 (not reloaded) click "Cancel registration".
5. Read the red message.
expected: After the reload, tab 1 shows the badge Attended, the line "Your attendance at this event is on record." and no "Register for this event" and no "Cancel registration" button. In tab 2 the click is refused with a red message such as "You have already attended this event and cannot cancel your registration." The student stays Attended. The message "You have already attended this event." belongs to a second Register request and can only be seen by a technical teammate sending it. VERIFY: the exact wording shown on the screen.

title: My attendance summary lists the check-ins the officer recorded
preconditions: Student 2100142 has been checked in to at least one event as Present and, if possible, one as Late (officer 900004 can choose the status). The code puts the "My attendance" panel on the Check-in tab, and the router only lets Admin and Officer open that page.
steps: 1. Open Events from the menu.
2. Look for a panel called "My attendance" on the page.
3. If you cannot find it, try the page address /dashboard/events/check-in and note where it sends you.
4. If you found it, read the tiles "Events attended", "Missed events" and "Attendance rate".
5. Read each record: event name, date and the status badge.
expected: Expected by design: a panel "My attendance" with the text "Based on recorded attendance only. Excused records are excluded from the rate." Tiles show Events attended (Present plus Late), Missed events (Absent) and Attendance rate. Each record shows a badge Present, Late, Excused or Absent. A student who never got checked in does not get a record here: that student sees the badge No-show on the event window instead. VERIFY: a student probably cannot reach this panel at all, because the Check-in address is limited to Admin and Officer. If it cannot be found anywhere on the student pages, report it as Blocked ("My attendance panel not reachable for students").

title: Order a product with sizes and see the message when no size is chosen
preconditions: Signed in as Student 2100142. The Admin has added a product with sizes, for example "QA Shirt" with S and M, each with its own stock (see ADM-176). Use Student 2300312 if 2100142 has orders in the way.
steps: 1. Open Store, Shop and find the card of the product with sizes.
2. Read the box "Size / variant". Open it and read the options.
3. Leave "Select variant" and tap "Add to Cart". Read the message.
4. Choose one size, keep quantity 1 and tap "Add to Cart".
5. Open the cart. Read the line of the product.
6. Tap "Review & Continue", keep Cash on pickup and tap "Place Reservation".
7. Open My orders and read the order.
expected: The size list shows each size with its stock, for example "M, 10 available", and a size with no stock is greyed out. With no size chosen the screen stops you with "Select a variant for <product name>." and the cart does not change. After you choose a size, a message like "1 x QA Shirt added to cart." appears and the cart line shows the size name before the price. The order is placed and My orders shows the order with the size you chose. The server message "Select a valid variant for this product." only appears if a request skips the screen, so a technical teammate has to send it.

title: Mute one kind of notification, trigger it, then turn it back on
preconditions: Signed in as Student 2100142. Admin 900001 is ready to publish an announcement on another device. Open the bell first and write down the unread number.
steps: 1. Open Profile and find the section "Notifications".
2. Switch "Announcements" off. Read the message.
3. The Admin publishes an announcement (Updates, Announcements, New announcement, Publish Now).
4. Reload the page. Read the bell number and open the bell.
5. Open Updates > Announcements and look for the same announcement.
6. Back in Profile switch "Announcements" on again. Reload and open the bell.
expected: Step 2 shows "Announcements hidden from your notifications". While it is off, the bell does not show "New Announcement: <title>" and the unread number does not go up, but the announcement is still in the Announcements feed. After you switch it on again, the bell shows the notice again (it was only hidden). The four switches are Announcements, Events and reminders, Elections and Merchandise orders. Approvals, tasks, account and payment notices cannot be switched off. VERIFY: that the notice made during the mute shows again after you turn the switch on.

title: A debt blocks Cleared; paying it and the signatures give Cleared
preconditions: The SAO opened a clearance period (SAO-079) and the Admin and Officer already signed for Student 2200055 (ADM-211 and SBO-087). Admin 900001 adds a charge of 150.00 to 2200055 (ADM-133) before step 1. Sign in as Student 2200055.
steps: 1. Open My payments, Statement of account.
2. Read "Outstanding balance" and "Clearance".
3. Open Support, My clearance and read "Signatures cleared".
4. The Admin records a full payment on the invoice (Finance, Student accounts, View account, Record payment).
5. Reload Statement of account and read both boxes again.
6. The SAO clears its own signature for this student (Reviews, Clearances).
7. Reload My clearance and Statement of account.
expected: With the debt, "Outstanding balance" shows 150.00 and "1 unpaid invoice", and "Clearance" shows On hold with the text "You owe 150.00: 1 unpaid invoice." It does not show Cleared. After the payment the balance shows 0.00 with "Nothing owed" and the Clearance box turns to a green Cleared with "Nothing owed and no clearance signature is on hold." My clearance still says "2 of 3" until the SAO signs. After the SAO signs, My clearance says "Your clearance is complete!" and Statement of account stays Cleared. VERIFY: Statement of account may show Cleared before the SAO signs, because it only checks debt and held signatures. Write down if this confuses you.
depends: Run after SAO-079, ADM-211, SBO-087, ADM-133 and ADM-135
